Privacy Policy

At Vishnu1000, we are committed to providing a pure, distraction-free devotional environment. We respect your spiritual space and your personal privacy. This privacy policy outlines how we handle user data.

1. Data Collection & Sharing

We collect zero user data. The app does not require any login, user registration, email address, phone number, or personal identifiers. We do not track your location, and we do not share any information with third parties.

2. Permissions & Local Storage

To ensure a smooth chanting experience, the app utilizes only the following local device permissions:

  • Local Storage: Your reading progress, chanting statistics, and daily Diya calendar streak are stored strictly on your local device. We have no backend server, and we cannot access this data.
  • Wake Lock: This standard permission allows the app to prevent the screen from going to sleep while you are actively reading the Sahasranama or chanting.

3. Advertisements & Trackers

The app contains zero advertisements, zero analytic trackers, and zero marketing pop-ups. Your prayers and practice remain completely private.

4. Contact Us

If you have any questions or feedback regarding this privacy policy, you can contact us directly at:

📧 Email: support@promankur.com
